exclude_selectors drops entire subtree unlike strip_tags which keeps children

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".wrapper\"]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<body><div class=\"wrapper\"><p>Inner paragraph</p></div><p>Outer text</p></body>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
